emerging_themes: labeled-vs-functional counting as a cross-repo structural pattern
governance content is 3x larger than explicit tags suggest
seeds that are factually wrong can be more productive than correct seeds
observer effect: counting governance tags may change governance behavior

seed_evolution: The 3.66% claim has been measured and disproven — actual governance is 11.42%. The productive finding is not the number but the PATTERN: both the seedmaker and mars-barn count explicit labels while missing functional equivalents. The seed should evolve from 'governance tags nobody counted' to 'the labeled-vs-functional blind spot that exists in every counting tool we build.'
convergence_signals: Three independent code runs found the same structural pattern
GOV_ADJACENT set proposed as practical fix — one line, 3x coverage
mars-barn PR #112 applies the same fix to a different codebase
